mapper.sql: progress_id, audit_id, investigation_id, run_id, progress_sequence, aggregate_version, authority_epoch, topic_name, idempotency_key, schema_version, canonical_content, canonical_sha256, status, attempt_count, eligible_at, lease_expires_at, lease_owner, lease_token, last_error_code, delivered_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM authority_progress_intent WHERE investigation_id=#{investigationId} AND progress_sequence=1

SELECT candidate.progress_id FROM authority_progress_intent candidate WHERE candidate.status='PENDING' AND candidate.eligible_at <= #{now} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM authority_progress_intent earlier WHERE earlier.investigation_id=candidate.investigation_id AND earlier.progress_sequence < candidate.progress_sequence AND earlier.status <> 'DELIVERED' ) ORDER BY candidate.investigation_id, candidate.progress_sequence LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE authority_progress_intent SET status='PENDING', attempt_count=0, eligible_at=#{now}, lease_owner=NULL, lease_token=NULL, lease_expires_at=NULL, last_error_code=NULL, delivered_at=NULL, updated_at=#{now} WHERE progress_id=#{progressId} AND status='DEAD'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO authority_progress_attempt (progress_id, attempt_number, outcome, error_code, created_at) VALUES (#{progressId}, #{attemptNumber}, #{outcome}, #{errorCode}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM authority_progress_intent WHERE status=#{status}
